s.n: Midnight liverwurst on rye and buttermilk
s.note: Bob and Betty's midnight snack in the inn kitchen
s.how: Spread 8 slices of rye bread with 30g soft butter and a thin layer of wholegrain mustard. Slice 250g liverwurst or smooth pork pâté and lay it over 4 of the slices. Top with thinly sliced dill pickles and a few rings of red onion, then the other slices of bread. Press down, trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into 4 fingers. Pour 400ml well-chilled buttermilk into 4 small glasses and serve together.

Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball, then cool. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time and 120g grated cheddar. Pipe small balls and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.how: Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with butter and herbs and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Bake stuffing made from 150g breadcrumbs, a diced onion, chopped sage and melted butter. Serve with cranberry sauce and 1kg roast potatoes.

w.note: the snow that finally falls on the inn
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs, then 250g self-raising flour, 60g coconut and 150ml coconut milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 28 minutes. Cover with 250g cream cheese beaten with 200g icing sugar and roll in the rest of the coconut.

d.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g sugar. Heat 600ml milk, 200ml cream and a cinnamon stick until steaming, whisk into the yolks and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon. Chill and serve with grated nutmeg and brandy on the side.
